reason: I don't take supplements unless my doctor says to, and I already forget the vitamins sitting on my counter. A sachet a day is one more thing to remember and one more piece of foil in the trash.
objection: I have no reason to think I need magnesium, and a foil sachet every day is packaging waste for something I'd probably skip half the time.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor telling me to take magnesium, and then a plain bottle or recyclable packaging instead of single-use foil.
